name: 織女銀鷗
illustrationTaxon: Larus vegae adult in non-breeding plumage. Vega Gull and Mongolian Gull cannot be separated objectively in the field (Collinson et al. 2008); the bird shown has medium-grey upperparts, an almost unstreaked white head, a heavy yellow bill with a red gonys spot and pink legs, which is how adults are identified in Hong Kong in winter. Juveniles and first-winter birds, which are browner and darker-billed, are not shown.

similarSpecies.distinction: 體型更大、胸更深、嘴更長、翼更長；翼上為更淡的銀灰色，初級飛羽黑色範圍更大，腳多為粉紅或桃色；成鳥一月前已完成初級飛羽換羽，因此冬末白色翼尖通常已磨損。本種翼上灰較深、換羽遲至十二月或一月。
翼上為明顯更深的石板灰（比本種深得多），體型較修長、翼較長、嘴較小；成鳥腳多為黃色，本種為粉紅。香港部分個體被視為與本種的雜交，結構、羽色或換羽居中，腳色由黃至粉紅不等。

featureNotes: 粗厚的黃色嘴，下嘴近端有明顯紅斑——成鳥最直接的特徵；第1圈取自近景圖，整條嘴連紅斑與嘴基都入圈。
成鳥冬季頭部幾乎純白，只在後頸與頸側留下幾道淡灰褐縱紋，這是與蒙古銀鷗（更素淨）分別時要看的位置（第2圈取自近景圖，實際可見）。
翼上為中等深淺的灰色，覆羽有整齊的疊瓦狀淡邊；與蒙古銀鷗的淡銀灰、烏灰銀鷗的深石板灰放在一起，灰階居中（第3圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。
初級飛羽黑色而末端有小小白點，最外一枚有白色「鏡斑」（第4圈取自全身圖，實際可見；插圖為停棲折翼狀態，不代表飛行時翼上翼下圖案）。

rangeMap.note: Country overview only: breeds in northeastern Siberia and winters in Japan, Korea, eastern and southern China and Taiwan; Hong Kong is within the winter range. Not an occurrence polygon and not split by season.

sources.use: HKBWS Mongolian Gull (017510) substantive read used as the source for Vega Gull size and separation: 56-68 cm for mongolicus, Vega Gull cannot be separated objectively from Mongolian Gull (Collinson et al. 2008); Mongolian Gull is larger, deeper-chested, longer-billed and longer-winged, paler grey above with more black in the primaries and pinkish/peachy legs, and completes primary moult by November whereas Vega Gull completes in December or January and Lesser Black-backed Gull at the end of February or early March; most Hong Kong records are from the Inner Deep Bay gull roost at Mai Po boardwalk on the falling tide; IUCN Least Concern, trend stable.

HKBWS Lesser Black-backed Gull (017700) read as the contrast species: 51-61 cm, medium-dark grey upperparts, yellow or predominantly yellow legs, extensive black in P8-P10 with one white mirror, primary moult complete end February/early March, minority are hybrids with Vega Gull; most records from the Inner Deep Bay roost; IUCN Least Concern, trend increasing.
HKBWS Slaty-backed Gull (017600) read to confirm it is a separate species (55-67 cm, slate-grey upperparts, pale iris) and is NOT what this card illustrates.
Runtime Chinese name 織女銀鷗 unchanged.

notes: AI 生成插圖，經人眼核對灰階、黃嘴紅斑、粉紅腳與黑翼尖白斑；不是照片，也不是分佈或族群證據。
織女銀鷗與蒙古銀鷗在野外無法客觀分開（Collinson et al. 2008），本卡採用香港冬季慣用的辨識要點（灰階、嘴形、換羽時間、腳色），不宣稱單一特徵足夠斷種。
比較鳥為 AI 生成示意，非等比例；三種灰階深淺只作對照參考。
地圖為 Natural Earth 110m 世界底圖的國家層級概述，不是精確分佈多邊形，繁殖地與越冬地不分工。
